Copy.m1vrtdq4: Maereg Tefere was born in the historic town of Lalibela and began his career as a local guide at its world-famous rock-hewn churches. With a professional tourism qualification, an official guiding licence and more than ten years in Ethiopian tourism, he has since led cultural tours, trekking adventures and community-based journeys across the country.
Copy.mlv9292: He still accompanies many groups personally, making sure every guest is comfortable, safe and well looked after, an attention to detail that has earned excellent feedback from travellers around the world.
